note: ARMED 2026-10-05: integration-tests.yml fails the job when a green vitest run EXECUTES fewer apps/web integration tests than expectedExecutedCount. The value is the executed count PRINTED by the green main run below (executed=491 collected=493 passed=491 failed=0 skipped=2), and was identical on the four most recent green main runs (37246651477, 37247767049, 37247975520, 37250553154). The run before them printed 486, before tests were added. Never set it from a local run, and never from the audit's '52', which counted FILES, not blocks. Raise it only by adding tests; lower it only in the PR that removes them. The floor governs the apps/web integration step only, not the packages/db step. Skip/flaky/todo bucket mapping (verified against vitest 3.2.4 JsonReporter source, not assumed): the JSON report has NO separate flaky bucket - a test that fails then passes on retry lands in 'passed', so executed = passed + failed is complete even with retries on; skipped / todo / pending are the not-executed buckets. This differs from the Playwright report the ported-from e2e step reads, which has a fourth 'flaky' stats bucket.
